description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into a linked list of tokens, along with helper functions to validate tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them as a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is valid (non-empty).
